title: Covalent organic frameworks as superior adsorbents for the removal of toxic substances
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00591K, Review Article
Yubo Li, Jinxia Wei, Jian Wang, Yuanyuan Wang, Peishuang Yu, Yao Chen, Zhenjie Zhang
This review discusses the design strategies of COFs for the removal of toxicants, and highlights the recent advancements in COFs as robust candidates for efficient removal of various types of toxicants.
